{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33317181/1dadd82412b19c9bd0cfb113e119466c25d67522.png

Get Moonfall Ultimate for 66% off for a Limited Time only!

Remote Play Together! 

Instantly share your Steam local multi-player games with friends over the internet, for free.
Using Remote Play Together, one player owns and runs the game, then up to four players — or even more with fast connections — can quickly join in the fun.

How does it work? 

1. Launch Moonfall Ultimate with support for Remote Play Together

2. From your friends list, invite anyone to play

3. They accept and you are now playing together

Buy Moonfall Ultimate here! and Discover a story of The Empire, a once small kingdom now under threat from so-called Savages. They hunt a mysterious element known as Lunarium which resides in The Empire and you, a dauntless recruit, must protect the land at the front line.

notes.title: MOONFALL ULTIMATE IS HERE (20% LAUNCH SALE)
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/xwQoXG6.gif

HELLO FOLKS!

Moonfall Ultimate has arrived with a 20% launch discount across all platforms!

We're so pleased to bring you this entriely hand-painted, side-scrolling RPG beat' em up, inspired by classics such as Golden Axe! Want to know all the features? Here's what you can expect...


 Beautifully hand-painted 2D graphics full of detail and dark atmospherics.
 Play the Campaign or Endless Mode solo or grab a friend with the 2-player couch co-op support.
 Three character classes with unique active and passive abilities. Choose Vanguard, Elementalis or Shadow to suit your play style.
 A sturdy levelling system and in-game economy which gives access to over 80 unique items. Fight, collect and upgrade!
 Action-packed combat system provides a diverse choice of dealing damage. A suitable strategy is the key to success.
 13 open-ended and fully explorable levels with elements of the metroidvania genre and packed with quests, boss fights and notes expanding the lore.
 Over 60 tiered enemies, each with their own unique attack and defensive attributes.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/853940/

Some of you may have noticed this is a new and improved version of the original "Moonfall" game. A free upgrade to all those who originally had Moonfall is available and has automatically been added to your library (you can still play and keep the original version too!) So what exactly is new?


 Local multiplayer support up to 2 players
 Endless arcade mode (1-2 players)
 Cinematic story intro
 Minor tweaks to combat system
 Full PS4 & Xbox controller support
 Optimisation pass



If you happen to come across any bugs whilst playing the game, we will work as fast as we can to iron them out for an upcoming patch. Please feel free to make a note of any over in the Steam forum. 

Thank you all for reading! You can follow Wales Interactive or Fishcow Studio with the links below.

notes.title: Moonfall Ultimate is coming soon!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33317181/6591213ff0e7b2e1abcd1008de74a7d166d7e249.jpg

Hello everyone! We are Wales Interactive, bringing you news on the release of Moonfall Ultimate — a 2D side-scrolling, action-RPG by developers Fishcow Studio. 

The entirely hand-painted beat 'em up is coming to Steam, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch on 4th September, with the Xbox One release on 5th September.

Moonfall... ULTIMATE

Some of you may have noticed this is a new and improved version of the original "Moonfall" game and now features two new game modes: 

 2-player Couch Co-op Campaign
 Endless Arcade Mode


https://youtu.be/Hd2b-9oC8-w

TELL ME MORE

Set in an industrial gothic universe, you'll hack, slash and cast your way through a treacherous hand-painted world. Choose your class and upgrade your gear with metroidvania-style exploration and a focus on strategic real-time combat.

Discover a story of The Empire, a once small kingdom now under threat from so-called Savages. They hunt a mysterious element known as Lunarium which resides in The Empire and you, a dauntless recruit, must protect the land at the front line.

Beautifully hand-painted 2D graphics full of detail and dark atmospherics.
Play the Campaign or Endless Mode solo or grab a friend with the 2-player couch co-op support.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33317181/ac1862c786a997e00f8024f4402051fb7fa79967.png

GIVE ME THOSE FEATURES


 Three character classes with unique active and passive abilities. 
 Choose Vanguard, Elementalis or - Shadow to suit your play style.
 A sturdy levelling system and in-game economy which gives access to over 80 unique items. Fight, collect and upgrade!
 Action-packed combat system provides a diverse choice of dealing damage. A suitable strategy is the key to success.
 13 open-ended and fully explorable levels with elements of the metroidvania genre and packed with quests, boss fights and notes expanding the lore.
 Over 60 tiered enemies, each with their own unique attack and defensive attributes. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33317181/7cd11cae41cb11aff9204a2bb202c413cf66bcfe.png

A few words from the developer...

"We are very pleased to be able to offer Moonfall Ultimate for our players on PC and consoles early in September 2018.  We believe, that special game modes will delight many players, especially local multiplayer will bring a lot of fun.

We are honoured that we could cooperate with the professional team from Wales Interactive, and we are proud that our game will be published by such a successful British publisher. Together, we will try to bring more games of  the high quality level in which players spend many great experiences that will remain in their memories for a long time." Stefan Nitkulinec, Project Director at Fishcow Studio.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33317181/5c1736938e734edf6a2cf390f97f9347b58dc6d9.png

Get in touch

Thank you all for reading! If you'd like to support the game then don't forget to add it to your Steam Wishlist.
